name: examples
title: Example pages
description: The demo pages (overview with charts; orders with infinite scroll over 2,000 orders, the Detail, new and edit forms and the customer Detail opened as a Dialog roteado by intercepted routes, each also a full page; empty state; settings; and the 2-step Quick order in the mobile flow, also opened in the dialog) with sample data and a fake back end. Install to start from a working back office.

import { Download, Plus, Zap } from "lucide-react"
import type { Metadata } from "next"
import Link from "next/link"
import { Suspense } from "react"

import { TableSkeleton } from "@/components/data-table/table-skeleton"
import { PageContainer, PageHeader } from "@/components/shell/page-header"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

import { OrdersTable } from "./orders-table"

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Orders" }

export default function OrdersPage() {
  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <PageHeader
        title="Orders"
        description="Every order across channels. Click a row for details."
        actions={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline">
              <Download aria-hidden />
              Export
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" asChild>
              <Link href="/quick-order">
                <Zap aria-hidden />
                Quick order
              </Link>
            </Button>
            <Button asChild>
              <Link href="/orders/new">
                <Plus aria-hidden />
                New order
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      />
      <Suspense fallback={<TableSkeleton />}>
        <OrdersTable />
      </Suspense>
    </PageContainer>
  )
}

"use client" import { useRouter } from "next/navigation" import * as React from "react" import { toast } from "sonner" import { markItemChanged, markItemCreated } from "@/components/data-table/list-updates" import { FormSection } from "@/components/forms/form-section" import { RoutedDialogBody, RoutedDialogDescription, RoutedDialogFooter, RoutedDialogHeader, RoutedDialogTitle, useRoutedDialog, useRoutedDialogDirty, } from "@/components/routed-dialog/routed-dialog" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, FieldTitle, } from "@/components/ui/field" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select" import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch" import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea" import { type Order, type OrderStatus, statusMeta } from "@/lib/data/orders" import { saveOrder } from "./actions" type Errors = Partial> const channels: Order["channel"][] = ["Website", "Partner", "Phone"] /** * Create or edit an order. The same form is a Dialog roteado over the list (`@modal/(.)orders/new`, * `@modal/(.)orders/[id]/edit`) and a full page at the same URL. * Plain controlled form to show the layout and error states; in a real project, plug in * react-hook-form or TanStack Form + zod, and the markup stays the same. */ export function OrderForm({ order }: { order?: Order }) { const router = useRouter() const frame = useRoutedDialog() const [errors, setErrors] = React.useState({}) const [channel, setChannel] = React.useState(order?.channel ?? "") const [status, setStatus] = React.useState(order?.status ?? "pending") const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false) const [dirty, setDirty] = React.useState(false) useRoutedDialogDirty(dirty) const editing = !!order const title = editing ? `Edit ${order.id}` : "New order" /** Back where the form was opened from: the Detail when editing from it, else the list. */ const leave = (options?: { force?: boolean; refresh?: boolean }) => { if (frame.mode === "dialog") frame.back(options) else router.push(editing ? `/orders/${order.id}` : "/orders") } async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) { e.preventDefault() const data = new FormData(e.currentTarget) const next: Errors = {} const customer = String(data.get("customer") ?? "").trim() if (!customer) next.customer = "Enter the customer's name." const email = String(data.get("email") ?? "") if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) next.email = "Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com." const amount = Number(data.get("amount")) if (!amount || amount <= 0) next.amount = "Enter an amount greater than 0." if (!channel) next.channel = "Choose where the order came from." setErrors(next) const firstInvalid = (["customer", "email", "amount", "channel"] as const).find((k) => next[k]) if (firstInvalid) { document.getElementById(firstInvalid)?.focus() return } setPending(true) const saved = await saveOrder(order?.id ?? null, { customer, email, amount, channel: channel as Order["channel"], status, }) setPending(false) if (!saved) return setDirty(false) // The list behind fetches this order again when the dialog closes. if (editing) markItemChanged("orders", saved.id) else markItemCreated("orders", saved.id) toast.success(editing ? `${saved.id} saved` : "Order created", { description: editing ? undefined : `${saved.id} was added to the queue.`, }) leave({ force: true, refresh: editing }) } return (
